scope: Original HA multiple dropdown chips and search popup only. Candidate implementation/calibration is pending. Explicit visible-list modes, full browser/framework breadth and application acceptance remain required.
capturePolicy: Fresh document per state; original module functions unchanged; same fictional public inputs and actual pointer/keyboard actions. Eight settled computed frames plus at least three raw PNG captures and two consecutive identical frames. Original PNG bytes are copied unchanged only after independent repeat equality.
semantics: Original wrapper uses selected chips plus an inline modal search popup. Authored accessible names, focus semantics and typed controlled form policy require separate candidate tests. Disabled chips are mapped through their original public disabled property because the observed wrapper does not forward it; all original multiple options are enabled because its item mapping drops per-option disabled flags. Candidate behavior must preserve its own validated disabled-option policy.
